title: People Ops - Manager Prep Q1 2026
content:
Quick notes for 1:1 + upward review prep (Q1 2026)

Context: low-key manager prep doc — talking points for my 1:1 with Lina and the skip-level with VP. Mostly bullets, examples, and asks.

Highlights / wins (Jan–Feb):
- Closed 6 IC hires (SWE/infra/infra-sre) — Avg time-to-offer: 25 days (goal 30).
- Rolled out new interview scorecard for infra candidates with engineeringmates; initial feedback good (less variance on system design weighting).
- Launched Benefits Refresh comms (401k vendor switch + new EAP vendor) — 72% open rate on announcement, 48 people asked follow-ups.
- Reduced onboarding completion time from 12 days -> 8 days by simplifying initial setup checklist and adding a one-hour "day-0" orientation slot.
- Escalation handling: managed two urgent visa cases — worked with legal + finance to expedite payroll hold resolution; both onboarded without missed start dates.

Areas to improve / challenges:
- Recruiting pipeline for senior infra is thin; need to invest in targeted sourcing and referral incentives. 3 reqs open >60 days.
- 1:1 cadence slipped for 2 direct reports in Jan due to travel; want to re-establish weekly check-ins and better coverage when OOO.
- Manager training rollout adoption slower than expected (only ~40% of managers completed the async module). Need a clearer incentive + follow-up schedule.

Specific examples to surface in review (behaviors + impact):
- Cross-functional: partnered with Serving Runtime eng to define interview rubric and helped refine technical exercise — resulted in two offers accepted with positive hiring manager feedback.
- Operational: removed a repetitive step in offboarding that saved ~20 min per offboard; estimated monthly time savings ~10 hours.
- People leadership: coached an IC on taking ownership of incident postmortems; they now lead retro for their team and improved incident RCA completeness.

Metrics to call out (data-backed):
- Hiring: 6 hires (Jan–Feb), 4 offers accepted / 7 offers extended = 57% acceptance on extended offers (benchmark to discuss).
- Time-to-fill: median 25 days; senior infra median 68 days.
- Onboarding completion (first 14 days): 82% complete vs 64% baseline prior to checklist change.
- Manager training completion: 40% completed, target 85% by end of Q2.

Career goals & development (my asks):
- Short term (next 6 months): lead 2 cross-team initiatives (manager enablement + recruiting playbook for infra), own a small headcount plan for Dedicated team.
- Medium term (12–18 months): move into Sr. People Partner scope (manage multiple teams, own strategic workforce planning). Looking for stretch opportunities in workforce planning and executive partner work.
- Coaching ask: want regular feedback on influencing senior engineering leaders and running strategic hiring forums.

Requests for manager / support needed:
- Approve $12k for targeted sourcing program for senior infra (contract sourcers + LinkedIn recruiter credits). Rationale: 3 reqs >60d; expected to reduce time-to-fill by 20–30 days.
- Support from Lina to push manager-training completion — a brief all-hands ask + two weeks of focus time from IC leads to complete modules.
- One skip-level intro note to VP of Eng to open door for quarterly hiring syncs.

Open questions / discussion items for 1:1:
- Is elevating me to run the Dedicated headcount planning for H2 a reasonable next step? What evidence would you want to see?
- How do you prefer I present the hiring pipeline to execs — raw reqs vs. prioritized slate?
- Any concerns about my bandwidth if I take on the sourcing program? (I estimate +0.2 FTE for 3 months with contractor help)

To-dos (quick list):
- [ ] Finalize sourcing vendor shortlist and formal request by 2026-03-05.
- [ ] Prep 10–15 minute summary for skip-level (one-pager + top 3 asks).
- [ ] Send manager-training nudges + set deadline 2026-03-15.
- [ ] Document onboarding checklist changes in /confluence/people-ops/onboarding-checklist (link above).

Notes to self: keep examples short during skip-level. Focus on impact (time saved, hires closed, retention signals). Bring one story that shows partnering with infra engineering (technical credibility).

Draft elevator summary for skip-level (30–45s):
"We helped close 6 hires in Jan–Feb, shortened onboarding by ~4 days, and fixed two high-risk visa escalations. Biggest gap is senior infra sourcing — I'm proposing a targeted sourcing program that should materially reduce time-to-fill and keep our projects on schedule."


Rough feedback log (for calibration):
- Priya: "Nice impact metrics, would like more on retention — can we add 6-12 month retention target?"
- Lena: "Agree on sourcing, but consider a pilot first (1 req) to validate ROI."

End of notes.
